name: Downtown Jazz Night
description: An evening of live jazz featuring the city's finest local musicians. Expect smooth rhythms, great cocktails, and an intimate atmosphere that makes every seat feel like the front row.

name: React & Beyond Meetup
description: A monthly gathering for frontend engineers to share what they're building. This edition covers React Server Components, state management patterns, and a live demo of new Vite tooling.

name: Street Food Festival
description: Over 40 vendors bringing the best street food from across the continent. From suya and jollof to tacos and dumplings — come hungry. Live music and family activities all day.

name: Contemporary Art Exhibition
description: A curated showcase of emerging African artists working in oil, mixed media, and digital formats. The exhibition runs for three days with guided tours available on request.

name: Morning HIIT Bootcamp
description: A high-intensity outdoor workout session led by certified trainers. All fitness levels welcome. Bring water, a mat, and good energy. Sessions run every Saturday morning.

name: Afrobeats Live Concert
description: Three headline acts and two opening sets in one electrifying night. The venue holds 300 and it always sells out. Early arrival recommended for best standing positions.

name: Cloud Architecture Workshop
description: A hands-on full-day workshop covering AWS architecture patterns, cost optimization, and designing for scale. Attendees leave with working Terraform configs and reference diagrams.

name: Wine & Cheese Evening
description: A guided tasting experience exploring six wine varieties paired with artisan cheeses from local producers. Hosted by a certified sommelier. Intimate setting, maximum 30 guests.

name: Sculpture & Space
description: An outdoor installation by award-winning sculptor Amara Obi. The works explore the tension between urban growth and natural space. Free guided walk-throughs at 12pm and 4pm daily.

name: 5K Fun Run
description: A community 5K run through the streets of Ikoyi. Suitable for all paces — this is about participation, not competition. Medal and breakfast pack included for all finishers.

name: Open Mic & Poetry Night
description: A safe, supportive space for spoken word artists, poets, and storytellers. Sign up at the door to perform a 5-minute set, or just come to listen. Theme for this edition: Identity.

name: Node.js Performance Deep Dive
description: An advanced session on profiling and optimizing Node.js applications in production. Topics include event loop analysis, memory leak detection, and benchmarking strategies.

name: Yoga & Mindfulness Retreat
description: A half-day retreat combining gentle yoga flows, breathwork, and guided meditation. Set in a quiet garden space. Beginners welcome. Mats provided, light refreshments included.

name: Jollof Cook-Off Championship
description: Eight competing cooks. One pot each. A panel of judges and an audience vote decide the champion. Attendees get to taste all entries. This year's prize: ₦500,000 and bragging rights.

name: Highlife Legends Tribute Night
description: A tribute concert celebrating the golden era of West African highlife music. Live band. Classic arrangements. A night for those who remember — and those ready to discover.
